Rank 1 Ki Technique

  • Ki Cost: 10 Ki per +1 bonus
  • Prerequisites: None
  • Casting Time: 1 Reaction when you are forced to make a Constitution, Dexterity, or Strength Saving Throw
  • Range: Self
  • Chargeable?: Yes
  • Duration: Instantaneous
  • Type: Omni

Form a barrier of ki around you granting you a +1 bonus to the triggering Saving Throw. You may not increase this bonus beyond a +3 in this way.
